description: The image displays a donut chart with two concentric rings, representing data related to ambiguity in the context of social engineering attacks and large language models. The outer ring, labeled "(Outer)", is segmented into four colored sections with corresponding percentages: a dark blue segment at 49.0%, a medium blue segment at 47.7%, a lighter blue segment at 7.0%, and a very light blue segment at 5.0%. The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)", is divided into three segments: a medium blue section at 39.0%, a light blue section at 38.0%, and a very light blue section at 14.2%. A legend on the right side of the chart provides a key for the outer ring, associating the dark blue color with "Std: 0.0", medium blue with "Std: 0.47", light blue with "Std: 0.82", and very light blue with "Std: 0.94". A second legend for the inner ring links the medium blue color to "Max: 1", light blue to "Max: 2", and very light blue to "Max: 3". The percentages are displayed directly within the respective segments of the chart.
